qualification_review.interpretation: Permission, renewed contact, community sensitivity, transcript correction, embargo handling, and later objections remain unresolved across parts of the collection.
qualification_review.limitations: This is a collection-level description and does not determine the lawful or appropriate access state of any individual interview.

records.interpretation: The collection director begins under pressure to expand access while honoring different release forms and risks to speakers, families, and living third parties.
records.limitations: This describes the opening tension before the library completes its operating policy.

records.interpretation: The library adopts separate permission procedures, five access states, named legal and community findings, a collection ledger, continuing batches, dated complaint review, and board capacity thresholds.
records.limitations: The policy governs collection work but does not predetermine the disposition of every recording.

records.interpretation: Many recordings still have unresolved permission, contact, sensitivity, correction, embargo, or complaint work after the policy takes effect.
records.limitations: The statement concerns the status of files across the collection rather than the merits of a particular access decision.
